title: PU-22-016 — Order on Protection of Information Order
text:
13 PU-22-16 Filed 05/04/2022 Pages: 2
Order on Protection of Information
Public Service Commission

Order
The Commission orders:

1. The specified information be withheld from public disclosure and the Public Service
Commission website.

2. That availability to the specified information be limited to the administrative law
judge, the Commission, counsel, and staff assigned to the captioned case.

PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION

Sheri Haugen-Hoff:

Commissioner
